svg.text: Twenty-five cycles, none alike: the peaks range from about 80 (the Dalton minimum, cycles 5–6, around 1800) to 285 (cycle 19, 1958). Orange lines: minima of the smoothed
series (the lowest within four years). Click a cycle number for its Wikipedia page. Caveat: before about 1850 the monthly values rest on few observers, and the series is SILSO's
2015 recalibration (version 2), not the historic Wolf numbers.
